title: Career Roadmap · Animator
summary: An Animator creates moving characters, objects and visual stories for films, television, games, advertising, digital media and educational content.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream; art and computer skills are useful.

blocks.label: Subjects
blocks.text: Visual arts, English, computer applications and design.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Drawing, storytelling, character design, movement and film-making.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Sketching, observation, creativity, visual storytelling and digital editing.

blocks.label: Entrance
blocks.text: Design institutes may require aptitude tests, drawing/design assessments and portfolio or interview stages. Check current notices.

items.text: Diploma in Animation / Multimedia → Entry-level 2D/3D animation and multimedia roles.

B.Des. in Animation Film Design → Character animation, storyboarding and animated filmmaking. NID Ahmedabad offers this programme.

Check university scholarships and bursaries; for example, Sheridan College lists international scholarship opportunities.
Sheridan College
No universal percentage cutoff applies. Eligibility may depend on income, category, domicile, admission status and course recognition. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Drawing, design fundamentals, animation principles and storytelling.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: 2D/3D software, modelling, rigging and storyboarding.

blocks.label: Year 3
blocks.text: Advanced animation, teamwork, production pipeline and internships.

blocks.label: Year 4, if applicable
blocks.text: Final showreel, capstone film and job/PG applications.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: 10-second character walk cycle; animated product advertisement; short story animation; 3D character with basic rig and facial expressions.

blocks.label: Studios / media
blocks.text: Animation production houses, VFX studios, game studios and post-production companies.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Advertising agencies, e-learning firms, digital-content studios and creative startups.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Check careers pages of Indian animation/VFX studios and gaming companies; openings vary.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: 2D animation, 3D character animation, storyboarding, modelling and compositing.
Internships and placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Specialized
blocks.text: 2D / 3D animation → Character, creature or motion-graphics specialization.

blocks.label: PG route
blocks.text: UG → M.Des. / relevant postgraduate programme → specialist or design-led roles.

Drawing, anatomy and visual storytelling

blocks.label: Pathway

items.text: Direct international hiring is possible for strong portfolios and suitable experience, but depends on vacancies, competition and work authorization. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.

blocks.text: Animation Student ↓ Intern / Junior Animator ↓ Animator ↓ Senior / Specialist Animator ↓ Lead Animator ↓ Animation Director / Creative Director / Studio Founder

CLASS 10 / 12 ↓ ANIMATION DIPLOMA / B.DES. / RELATED DEGREE ↓ DRAWING + STORYTELLING + 2D/3D TOOLS ↓ PROJECTS + SHOWREEL + INTERNSHIP ↓ JUNIOR ANIMATOR ↓ ANIMATOR → SENIOR / SPECIALIST ↓ LEAD / DIRECTOR / INDEPENDENT STUDIO
